items.title: Nike Exits the S&P 100 Index. 4 Tech Stocks Move In
items.summary: Nike drops out of the S&P 100 on September 21, 2026. Dell, Palo Alto, Arista and Sandisk move in, signaling a major shift toward tech stocks.

items.title: OPEC+ pauses oil output policy steady for October
items.summary: Investing.com -- OPEC+ will keep oil production steady in October, pausing a six-month run of output increases as the group shifts its focus to determining new production quotas for 2027, it said after Sunday’s meeting.

items.title: U.S.-Iran tanker war escalates as Hormuz disruption deepens
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S.-Iran conflict intensified over the weekend as Tehran claimed fresh attacks on a U.S.-operated drone boat and several commercial vessels, adding to a widening confrontation in the Strait of Hormuz after Washington struck three Iranian oil tankers, Al Jazeera reported on Sunday.

items.title: 3 All-Weather Dividend Stocks That Keep Writing Bigger Checks
items.summary: Some dividend stocks raise their payouts through one recession, maybe two. A handful of consumer staples names have kept writing bigger checks through every downturn for decades, and the cash flow behind that streak is more durable than most investors realize.

items.title: Canada’s trade surplus narrows in July as exports fall for first time in six month
items.summary: Investing.com -- Canada’s merchandise trade surplus narrowed sharply in July as exports fell for the first time in six months while imports rose, signalling renewed pressure on trade as the country faces heightened tariff uncertainty with the United States.
